actions.label: Receive input
actions.summary: Map public module input and authorized caller invocation fields into named ports.
actions.when_to_use: Use once at the start of a workflow.
actions.input_contract: Public input, explicitly selected host invocation fields or fixed values.
actions.control_effect: Publishes data; does not call an Agent.

output_meanings.task: The user’s current request together with the visible chat context.

actions.label: Delegate a task
actions.summary: Give a bounded task to a module and receive its report.
actions.when_to_use: Use for research, writing, calculations or other work done by an Agent Team.
actions.input_contract: Selected source fields and this instance’s own history.
actions.output_contract: A report or the structured fields you define.
actions.control_effect: Downstream nodes wait for the declared result; independent branches continue.
actions.context_rule: Uses only this module’s private context; does not transfer the conversation.

output_meanings.report: The complete result of this assigned task, with relevant evidence, calculations and uncertainty.

actions.label: Dispatch assignments
actions.summary: Write assignments and select which declared execution branches should run.
actions.when_to_use: Use for a fixed graph with selective task distribution and review-driven rework.
actions.input_contract: Goal, declared branch targets, own history and any rejected review feedback.
actions.output_contract: Declared assignment fields plus selected_nodes containing the target node IDs to execute.
actions.control_effect: The host validates selected branches. During rework it reuses unselected reports, reruns selected branches and reopens their dependants.
actions.context_rule: The dispatcher and each executor retain their own private contexts.

output_meanings.selected_nodes: Exact node IDs selected from this dispatcher’s declared targets. On rework choose only branches needing correction.

actions.label: Generate or revise a plan
actions.summary: Ask the Controller for a validated work graph or graph changes.
actions.when_to_use: Use when the work steps should adapt to the request and incoming reports.
actions.input_contract: Goal, available modules, graph state and selected reports.
actions.output_contract: A typed graph action, checked by the host.
actions.control_effect: May add or change unstarted work; cannot bypass protected review or boundary nodes.
actions.context_rule: Controller keeps its own private context.

output_meanings.action: A registered controller command describing graph creation, graph changes, waiting or requesting input. The host validates and executes this command.

actions.label: Review a result
actions.summary: Independently check evidence and produce an approval or concrete corrections.
actions.when_to_use: Use before delivery when an independent result check is required.
actions.input_contract: Original goal, candidate and referenced reports.
actions.output_contract: Verdict, checked reports, issues and approved answer.
actions.control_effect: Approval releases the answer; rejection follows the configured correction rule.
actions.context_rule: Reviewer has a separate private context.

output_meanings.verdict: approve when the requested result is supported; otherwise revise.
output_meanings.summary: A concise account of what was independently checked.
output_meanings.issues: Concrete unresolved errors or missing evidence; empty on approval.
output_meanings.checked_report_refs: The exact host-issued report IDs actually checked. Never invent IDs.
output_meanings.answer: The final user-facing answer on approval, in the requested format; empty when requesting corrections.

actions.label: Choose a branch
actions.summary: Ask a module to select one declared branch.
actions.when_to_use: Use when different outcomes need different next steps.
actions.output_contract: A declared case and an optional report.
actions.control_effect: Only edges for the selected case proceed.
actions.context_rule: Uses the bound module’s private context.

output_meanings.case: The declared branch name selected from this node’s cases.
output_meanings.report: The rationale for selecting this branch.

actions.label: Dispatch items
actions.summary: Run the same assignment for each item with separate execution contexts.
actions.when_to_use: Use to divide a document list or batch into independently processed items.
actions.input_contract: An item list plus shared selected inputs.
actions.output_contract: Item results, partial status and combined report.
actions.control_effect: Dispatches items under the shared call and concurrency limits.
actions.context_rule: Each item has a stable context separate from other items.

output_meanings.items: One outcome for each dispatched item, retaining its position and status.

actions.label: Collect reports
actions.summary: Collect reports without asking another model to rewrite or judge them.
actions.when_to_use: Use to gather independent answers or wait for the required result set.
actions.input_contract: References to the reports being collected.
actions.output_contract: Combined report, named results and outcome states.
actions.control_effect: Waits for all outcomes, all successes, first success or a configured quorum.
actions.context_rule: No Agent context is created or shared.

output_meanings.report: The collected replies kept separate and attributed to their input names.
output_meanings.results: The original values grouped by this collector’s local input names.
output_meanings.outcomes: The terminal execution state of each upstream node.

actions.label: Repeat with feedback
actions.summary: Repeat a module assignment until its stop condition or iteration limit is reached.
actions.when_to_use: Use for a bounded refinement loop.
actions.input_contract: Selected inputs and the previous iteration’s result.
actions.output_contract: Last result, iteration count, stop reason and report.
actions.control_effect: Repeats within the iteration and shared budgets.
actions.context_rule: Reuses this loop’s private module context.

output_meanings.stop_reason: Whether the stop condition or the iteration limit ended repetition.
output_meanings.report: The report from the last iteration.

actions.label: Ask the user
actions.summary: Pause this node until the user supplies a value.
actions.when_to_use: Use when execution needs a human answer rather than an Agent guess.
actions.input_contract: An explicit question and any selected context.
actions.output_contract: The user’s answer and a report.
actions.control_effect: This branch waits; independent ready branches may continue.
actions.context_rule: Does not call an Agent or copy private histories.

output_meanings.answer: The value supplied by the user to this question.
output_meanings.report: The user’s answer represented as text.

actions.label: Return supplied data
actions.summary: Return a value already available from inputs.
actions.when_to_use: Use to expose an existing result without an extra model call.
actions.input_contract: An answer, report or other selected values.
actions.output_contract: A report containing the supplied value.
actions.control_effect: Publishes the value when its dependencies are ready.

output_meanings.report: An existing supplied value exposed as this node’s result, without another model call.

actions.label: Expose public outputs
actions.summary: Map upstream values into the Workflow public output ports.
actions.when_to_use: Use once at the end of a workflow.
actions.output_contract: Named public output object; root chat chooses a delivery port.
actions.control_effect: Delivery still respects graph dependencies and protected review gates.

output_meanings.answer: The final answer selected from upstream results and delivered to the chat.

actions.label: Call a Workflow (legacy alias)
actions.summary: Legacy alias for module.call with an authorized saved Workflow binding.
actions.when_to_use: Existing definitions remain supported. New compositions use the common module.call Action.
actions.input_contract: The child Workflow public input object.
actions.output_contract: The child Workflow public output fields and attributed report.
actions.control_effect: Run a child graph with shared root budgets, deadline and slots.
actions.context_rule: A stable invocation path retains child role contexts across turns; separate paths are isolated.

output_meanings.report: The child public outputs serialized as text.

actions.label: Run workspace commands
actions.summary: Run administrator-approved named commands in an owned workspace.
actions.when_to_use: Run administrator-approved named commands in an owned workspace.
actions.input_contract: Declared immutable artifact references and Project-approved command IDs.
actions.output_contract: Host-owned revision, artifact, command/test or conflict receipts.
actions.control_effect: Runs inside the common dependency, cancellation and feedback scheduler.
actions.context_rule: Host-owned lease selected by a declared logical instance; no model-supplied paths.

output_meanings.report: The actual host outcome and evidence.
output_meanings.__workspace: Owned workspace revision and actual guarantees.

actions.label: Evaluate candidates
actions.summary: Test immutable candidate revisions in separate scratch environments against pinned authoritative checks.
actions.when_to_use: Test immutable candidate revisions in separate scratch environments against pinned authoritative checks.
actions.input_contract: Declared immutable artifact references and Project-approved command IDs.
actions.output_contract: Host-owned revision, artifact, command/test or conflict receipts.
actions.control_effect: Runs inside the common dependency, cancellation and feedback scheduler.
actions.context_rule: Host-owned lease selected by a declared logical instance; no model-supplied paths.

output_meanings.report: The actual host outcome and evidence.
output_meanings.__workspace: Owned workspace revision and actual guarantees.

actions.label: Integrate selected changes
actions.summary: Select one alternative or Git-merge explicitly selected immutable artifacts in a separate integration workspace.
actions.when_to_use: Select one alternative or Git-merge explicitly selected immutable artifacts in a separate integration workspace.
actions.input_contract: Declared immutable artifact references and Project-approved command IDs.
actions.output_contract: Host-owned revision, artifact, command/test or conflict receipts.
actions.control_effect: Runs inside the common dependency, cancellation and feedback scheduler.
actions.context_rule: Host-owned lease selected by a declared logical instance; no model-supplied paths.

output_meanings.report: The actual host outcome and evidence.
output_meanings.__workspace: Owned workspace revision and actual guarantees.

actions.label: Publish a revision
actions.summary: Publish the owned current workspace after resolving real file conflicts.
actions.when_to_use: Publish the owned current workspace after resolving real file conflicts.
actions.input_contract: Declared immutable artifact references and Project-approved command IDs.
actions.output_contract: Host-owned revision, artifact, command/test or conflict receipts.
actions.control_effect: Runs inside the common dependency, cancellation and feedback scheduler.
actions.context_rule: Host-owned lease selected by a declared logical instance; no model-supplied paths.

output_meanings.report: The actual host outcome and evidence.
output_meanings.__workspace: Owned workspace revision and actual guarantees.
